records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: ww The renal artery is derived from which of the following blood vessels:
records.explanation: The renal artery arises from the abdominal aorta just inferior to the origin of the superior mesenteric artery just between vertebrae L1 and L2 and posterior to the pancreas. : Vv

options: Skin over the genitalia (v’) skin over the lateral thigh 91%

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: ww The iliohypogastric nerve supplies skin over which of the following regions:
records.explanation: The iliohypogastric nerve is formed from the anterior rami of L1. It innervates the internal oblique and the transversus abdominis muscles and supplies posterolateral gluteal skin and skin over the pubic region. ‘ : ? Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: wy Which of the following is the most common position of the vermiform appendix:
records.explanation: The most common position is retrocaecal, followed by pelvic. ; Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: A 49 year old man presents to ED with a few months history of abdominal pain, weight loss and jaundice. Imaging shows a tumour in the uncinate process of the pancreas. Which of the following structures is most likely compressed by this tumour:
records.explanation: The uncinate process of the pancreas is a projection of the lower part of the head to the left behind the superior mesenteric vessels. Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: The lymphatics of the glans penis drain primarily to which of the following lymph nodes:
records.explanation: The lymphatics of the skin of the penis and prepuce drain primarily to the superficial inguinal lymph nodes. The lymphatics of the glans penis drain primarily to the deep inguinal lymph nodes. ee Py Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: ww Pain in the jejunum and ileum is typically referred to which of the following regions:
records.explanation: Pain from the small jejunum and ileum (midgut structures) is referred to the periumbilical region. Vv

records.stem: A75 year old man presents to ED complaining of abdominal pain radiating to his back, anorexia and weight loss. Imaging shows a large tumour of the neck of the pancreas. Which of the following structures is most likely compressed by the tumour:
records.explanation: The portal vein is formed from the union of the superior mesenteric and splenic veins posterior to the neck of the pancreas and would most likely be compressed by a tumour at this location. oo |e a Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: ww The termination of the abdominal aorta can be visualised on the anterior abdominal wall by a point:
options: Halfway between the xiphisternum and the umbilicus 3%
Halfway between the umbilicus and the pubic symphysis 8%
About 2.5 cm above the deep inguinal ring %
records.explanation: The main terminal branches of the abdominal aorta are the two common iliac arteries. This bifurcation can be visualised on the anterior abdominal wall as a point approximately 2.5 cm below the umbilicus. : v
